Privacy and storage

Updated 20 November 2026.

Study without an account

Your original PDFs are read on your device and are not uploaded by Honey Scholar. Guest answers and progress are stored in this tab's session storage. Closing the tab normally clears that storage; browser session restore may retain it. Use Clear or start a new worksheet to remove the current guest session.

Optional accounts

Google Firebase handles sign-in. Honey Scholar stores your email, account dates and favourite topics. Only tests you explicitly choose to save are stored in Cloudflare, including questions, answer keys, responses, progress and scores. Signing in alone does not save your worksheet.

Who can access saved information?

The admin screen shows account emails, account dates and aggregate counts, not private test content or individual scores. The site owner and infrastructure providers can technically access stored information to operate the service.

Storage, cookies and other services

Honey Scholar does not install advertising trackers or Google Analytics. It uses browser session storage for guest progress and session-based Firebase sign-in when requested. Hosting and authentication providers may use their own security mechanisms, cookies and logs. The Firebase code is loaded when you request account features.

Ask AI opens a separate service. Nothing is sent to that service until you copy and submit the prompt yourself; its own account limits and privacy rules apply.

Export and deletion

In My progress you can export saved data, delete a saved test or delete your account. Account deletion requires a recent sign-in. Deleted data may remain in provider backups for their retention period. Export anything you want to keep before deleting it.

Questions or problems

You can report a problem on GitHub. Reports are public: do not include private worksheets, passwords, tokens or account records.
